summary: Five-colour Scarecrow kindred where every body that enters is a Vindicate, and type hacks turn every token into another one.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Forty-six of the hundred cards are artifacts, including the commander and almost every Scarecrow.

tags.name: scarecrows
tags.reason: Twenty-five printed Scarecrows plus ten changelings; the creature type is the engine, not a theme.

tags.name: changelings
tags.reason: Ten changeling creatures are run specifically because they count as Scarecrows with no support.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: The whole plan is Reaper King's enter trigger, doubled by Panharmonicon and Elesh Norn and reset by Conjurer's Closet.

tags.name: type hack
tags.reason: Maskwood Nexus, Xenograft, Arcane Adaptation, and Conspiracy exist only to make other creatures count as Scarecrows.

tags.name: color hack
tags.reason: Painter's Servant, Scuttlemutt, Scrapbasket, and Grand Architect all recolour permanents to turn on abilities.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Pili-Pala with Grand Architect for infinite mana, and Painter's Servant with Grindstone to deck a player.

tags.name: creatures
tags.reason: Over forty creatures, and the deck's clock is a wide anthemed board.

tags.name: mana dorks
tags.reason: Seven Scarecrows tap or filter for mana and double as the trigger fodder.

tags.name: midrange
tags.reason: The deck deploys bodies, grinds permanents off the table, and wins in the mid to late game.

tags.name: shapeshifters
tags.reason: The changeling package is entirely Shapeshifter creatures.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Mirrorworks, Prototype Portal, Genesis Chamber, Bitterblossom, Kher Keep, and Irregular Cohort all make bodies that trigger the King.

tags.name: -1/-1 counters
tags.reason: Grim Poppet, Chainbreaker, Dread Tiller, Fang Skulkin, and The Reaper form a small sub-package.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Sculpting Steel and Phyrexian Metamorph copy the best artifact on the table.

tags.name: mana rocks
tags.reason: Chromatic Lantern, Coalition Relic, and Fellwar Stone support the five-colour cost.

tags.name: multicolor matters
tags.reason: Nothing rewards multicolour directly, but the commander's hybrid cost drops by five when all five colours are online.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Solemn Simulacrum, Burnished Hart, Scaretiller, and Wayfarer's Bauble, mostly in service of fixing.

tags.name: toolbox
tags.reason: Inventors' Fair finds the artifact the board needs.

tags.name: mill
tags.reason: Only Grindstone, and only alongside Painter's Servant.

tags.name: reanimator
tags.reason: Scarecrone and Graveshifter rebuy bodies; there is no reanimation plan.
